title: Build the management plane around a jump server
scenario: Ardennes Logistics has put a jump server between its administrators and its servers, and has then left every direct path open alongside it, which makes the jump server decoration rather than a control. You are writing the rule set on the stateful firewall between the zones so that the only route to a management port runs through JUMP-01. First match wins, and anything not permitted is denied.
requirements: Administrators on ADMIN-VLAN reach JUMP-01 over SSH, and nothing else on it.
Only JUMP-01 may reach SERVER-VLAN on the management ports, SSH and RDP.
No workstation and no administrator may reach a server management port directly. The point of a jump server is that it is the only door.
Nothing from the internet may reach JUMP-01. A jump server is an internal choke point, not a remote access gateway.
Servers must never initiate connections back toward ADMIN-VLAN. A compromised server pivoting into the admin network is the failure this design exists to prevent.
Finish with an explicit deny so blocked management attempts are logged.
Apply least privilege. A rule permitting more than the requirement asks for earns no credit even if the required traffic works.
